digest.component_or_area: CLI confirmation path and verb lifecycle documentation
propositions: Structural test assertions must verify that confirmation output is routed exclusively through the shared _confirm.emit/emit_text seam for create, link, and transition verbs, catching regressions that bypass the seam.
A durable, test-enforced verb inventory table must document which mutations are no-op-capable versus always-write, with CI drift detection when verbs are added without classification.

The pre-merge (42cd70b889^) to post-merge confirmation-line mapping for each verb must be recorded as golden data in generated documentation with old strings extracted from git history, not paraphrased.
Confirmation formatters must produce output without requiring store reads, verified by formatting in isolated environments with empty temporary directories and REBAR_ROOT unset.
